name: Natalia Winterfeld
source: Natalia is the very definition of the word 'odd'. Her cold demeanor - a result of her being utterly socially inept - and her fancy style of clothing definitely make her stand out. She may make up for it by being a loyal person, but it may be that something dark is hidden in her past. Something that could make her loyalty dangerous.
